faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Here are some questions you may have before starting a project with Saskardigital.

questions.question: Does Saskardigital accept custom software projects?
questions.answer: Yes. We develop digital solutions based on your business needs, workflows, and processes.

questions.question: Can you build a company profile website?
questions.answer: Yes. We create professional company profile websites tailored to your brand identity and business needs.

questions.question: Can you develop an application from scratch?
questions.answer: Yes. We can handle the entire process, from requirements analysis and system planning to application development.

questions.question: Can you continue or improve an existing system?
questions.answer: Yes. We can evaluate your existing system, technology, and application before planning further development.

questions.question: How do I start a project with Saskardigital?
questions.answer: We start with a consultation to understand your needs, discuss the right solution, and prepare a proposal based on your project requirements.

questions.question: How long does a project take to complete?
questions.answer: The timeline depends on the project’s complexity, features, and requirements. We will provide a timeline estimate after understanding your needs.

questions.question: Do you provide maintenance and support after the project is completed?
questions.answer: Yes. We offer maintenance and support services to help keep your system running smoothly and ready for future improvements.

questions.question: Can I consult with you before deciding on a project?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We recommend starting with a consultation so we can understand your business needs and challenges before deciding on the right solution.

questions.question: Can a project be developed gradually based on our budget?
questions.answer: Yes. Projects can be developed in stages by prioritizing the most important features first and adding more functionality as your needs grow.

questions.question: Does Saskardigital work with businesses outside your city?
questions.answer: Yes. Consultation, communication, and project development can all be handled online, allowing us to work with businesses from different locations.
